section_1_cloze.passage:
When the electric cars initially hit the market, my husband had been thinking about buying one for months, about which we had quarreled. Despite its advantages, I didn't fully [41] it until my husband test-drove an electric car after we moved to California. I needed to [42] 80 miles round trip to and from work every day, and it would be unusual if the car could make the whole [43] on a single charge. So, we finally decided to buy a battery-powered one.
Everything was [44] until one Friday. We had planned to meet in Palo Alto after work, which is a city 22 miles from our [45]. After that, we would go home together.
Arriving at Palo Alto, my husband was [46] when the car's dashboard (仪表板) showed there were only 19 miles left on the charge. That's because, according to his phone app, there are a lot of [47] stations in Palo Alto. But it seems that there are [48] a lot of electric cars in the city. When he got to the parking garage, he found that all the charging spots were [49] by other cars. California wants to [50] enough charging stations for 1 million zero-emission cars, but obviously it has a long way to go.
With the appointed time approaching, he [51] to give up charging and meet me first. After the meeting, we [52] the garage where he left the car, but the charging spots were still taken. We calmed down ourselves and went to the next garage. [53], there was one empty charger. My husband pulled the line from the charger and [54] it into the front snout (接口) of the car, and settled in to wait.
"Our marriage survived our first charging crisis," I said with [55]. "Welcome to life with an electric car in California," he replied.

questions.explanation: 空格前提到作者和丈夫因为买电动车发生过争吵，说明作者起初是不支持的；空格后提到直到搬到加州试驾后才改变态度。believe in（相信，信任其价值/可靠性）符合语境。refer to意为“提及，参考”；give up意为“放弃”；figure out意为“弄清楚”，均不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(refer to)：语境句：Please refer to the dictionary if you don't know the word. 固定搭配：refer to as, refer to a dictionary
B(believe in)：语境句：I strongly believe in the power of teamwork. 固定搭配：believe in oneself, believe in God
C(give up)：语境句：He refused to give up his dream of becoming a doctor. 固定搭配：give up doing sth, give up hope
D(figure out)：语境句：It took me a long time to figure out the solution. 固定搭配：figure out a problem, figure out a way

questions.explanation: 根据后文“80 miles round trip”以及整篇文章探讨买车和开车的话题可知，作者每天上下班需要“开车（drive）”往返80英里。
questions.supplement:
A(drive)：语境句：She learns to drive a car at the age of eighteen. 固定搭配：drive safely, drive sb crazy
B(walk)：语境句：We decided to walk to the park instead of taking a bus. 固定搭配：take a walk, walk away
C(ride)：语境句：He likes to ride his bike to school every day. 固定搭配：ride a bike, ride a horse
D(run)：语境句：She likes to run in the park every morning to keep fit. 固定搭配：run out of, run away

questions.explanation: 前文提到“80 miles round trip”（往返80英里的行程），因此如果车充一次电就能完成整个“行程（trip）”，那将会很不可思议。procedure（程序）、program（项目）、task（任务）均与通勤语境不符。
questions.supplement:
A(trip)：语境句：We went on a school trip to the museum last week. 固定搭配：make a trip, round trip
B(procedure)：语境句：You must follow the safety procedure in the laboratory. 固定搭配：medical procedure, legal procedure
C(program)：语境句：The school has launched a new reading program. 固定搭配：computer program, training program
D(task)：语境句：She accomplished the challenging task ahead of schedule. 固定搭配：perform a task, difficult task

questions.explanation: 句意：一切都很好（fine），直到某个星期五。until引导转折，暗示星期五发生了不愉快的事情，所以在那之前一切正常或顺利。tough（艰难的）、wrong（错误的）与语境相反；special（特殊的）不如fine自然。
questions.supplement:
A(tough)：语境句：It was a tough decision to make, but necessary. 固定搭配：a tough job, tough luck
B(special)：语境句：This necklace has a special meaning to me. 固定搭配：special offer, special attention
C(wrong)：语境句：I think there is something wrong with my computer. 固定搭配：go wrong, prove sb wrong
D(fine)：语境句：The weather was fine and we enjoyed our picnic. 固定搭配：doing fine, fine art

questions.explanation: 根据语境，他们下班后在Palo Alto见面，而这个城市距离他们的“家（house）”有22英里。后文“we would go home together”也呼应了此处的house。
questions.supplement:
A(station)：语境句：We arrived at the train station just in time. 固定搭配：train station, gas station
B(hotel)：语境句：We stayed at a five-star hotel during our holiday. 固定搭配：book a hotel, stay at a hotel
C(house)：语境句：They are building a new house in the suburbs. 固定搭配：move house, keep house
D(camp)：语境句：The kids set up a camp in the forest. 固定搭配：summer camp, set up camp

questions.explanation: 这是一个易错题。通常电量剩19英里会让人不安，但后文紧接着解释“That's because... there are a lot of charging stations”，说明丈夫此时并不慌张，反而很“自信（confident）”，因为他知道有很多充电站。如果选upset（心烦意乱的），后文的because逻辑就解释不通。
questions.supplement:
A(upset)：语境句：She was deeply upset by the bad news. 固定搭配：get upset, feel upset
B(cheerful)：语境句：He always has a cheerful attitude towards life. 固定搭配：cheerful smile, cheerful voice
C(guilty)：语境句：He felt guilty about lying to his parents. 固定搭配：feel guilty, plead guilty
D(confident)：语境句：She is confident that she will pass the exam. 固定搭配：be confident in, feel confident

questions.explanation: 文章讨论的是电动车，手机App显示的必然是“充电（charging）”站。gas stations是加油站，不符合电动车的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(railway)：语境句：The new railway connects the two major cities. 固定搭配：railway station, railway network
B(charging)：语境句：My phone battery is dead and needs charging. 固定搭配：charging station, charging cable
C(gas)：语境句：We need to stop at the next gas station. 固定搭配：gas station, natural gas
D(broadcasting)：语境句：The broadcasting company will air the match live. 固定搭配：broadcasting station, broadcasting network

questions.explanation: 前句提到有很多充电站，这句转折“但是似乎城市里‘也（also）’有很多电动车”，导致充电站不够用。thus表示因果，again表示再次，never表示从不，均不符合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(thus)：语境句：He didn't work hard, and thus failed the exam. 固定搭配：thus far
B(again)：语境句：Please read the instructions and try again. 固定搭配：time and again, once again
C(never)：语境句：I have never been to such a beautiful place. 固定搭配：never mind, now or never
D(also)：语境句：She is a talented singer and also a great dancer. 固定搭配：not only... but also

questions.explanation: 根据上下文，城市里电动车很多，所以到了停车场发现所有充电车位都被其他车“占据（occupied）”了。abandoned意为废弃，bought意为购买，均不合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(abandoned)：语境句：The abandoned factory was torn down last year. 固定搭配：abandoned building, abandoned vehicle
B(occupied)：语境句：All the seats in the meeting room were occupied. 固定搭配：fully occupied, be occupied with
C(bought)：语境句：He bought a bouquet of flowers for his mother. 固定搭配：buy off, buy out
D(mistaken)：语境句：You are entirely mistaken about his intentions. 固定搭配：be mistaken about, mistaken identity

questions.explanation: 加州想要“建设（construct）”足够的充电站来满足100万辆零排放汽车的需求。replace（取代）、control（控制）、combine（结合）均与建设充电站的语意不符。
questions.supplement:
A(replace)：语境句：We need to replace the old tires on our car. 固定搭配：replace A with B
B(control)：语境句：He struggled to control his anger during the meeting. 固定搭配：out of control, under control
C(construct)：语境句：The city plans to construct a new bridge over the river. 固定搭配：construct a building, construct a theory
D(combine)：语境句：The project will combine theory with practical experience. 固定搭配：combine A with B, combine into

questions.explanation: 随着约定的见面时间临近，由于找不到充电位，他“决定（decided）”先放弃充电去见作者。refused（拒绝）、promised（承诺）、pretended（假装）均不符合他做出让步选择的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(refused)：语境句：He politely refused their invitation to the dinner. 固定搭配：refuse to do sth, refuse an offer
B(promised)：语境句：She promised her friend that she would keep the secret. 固定搭配：promise to do sth, make a promise
C(pretended)：语境句：The boy pretended to be asleep when his mother came in. 固定搭配：pretend to do sth, pretend that
D(decided)：语境句：They finally decided to spend their holiday in Spain. 固定搭配：decide to do sth, decide on

questions.explanation: 见完面后，他们“返回（returned to）”他停车的车库继续尝试充电。searched for（寻找）、looked into（调查）、focused on（集中于）都不如returned to精准贴合“回到原车库”的动作。
questions.supplement:
A(returned to)：语境句：After years abroad, he finally returned to his hometown. 固定搭配：return to normal, return to work
B(searched for)：语境句：The rescue team searched for the missing hikers all night. 固定搭配：search for evidence, search for a job
C(looked into)：语境句：The police have looked into the mysterious disappearance. 固定搭配：look into a matter, look into the future
D(focused on)：语境句：You should stay focused on your studies right now. 固定搭配：focus on details, focus attention on

questions.explanation: 前文说他们去了下一个车库，这里说有一个空充电桩，这种转折表明是运气好，“幸运的是（Fortunately）”。
questions.supplement:
A(Fortunately)：语境句：Fortunately, no one was injured in the terrible accident. 固定搭配：fortunately enough
B(Regularly)：语境句：You should exercise regularly to maintain good health. 固定搭配：on a regular basis, regularly check
C(Hopefully)：语境句：Hopefully, the weather will be sunny for our trip tomorrow. 固定搭配：hopefully soon
D(Gradually)：语境句：The pain in his leg gradually disappeared after the treatment. 固定搭配：gradually improve, gradually increase

questions.explanation: 丈夫拉过充电线，然后将它“插进（plugged）”汽车前面的接口。plug into意为“把……插入（插座/接口等）”，符合给电动车充电的动作。
questions.supplement:
A(showed)：语境句：The teacher showed the students how to solve the problem. 固定搭配：show off, show up
B(plugged)：语境句：He plugged his laptop into the socket to charge it. 固定搭配：plug in, plug into
C(dragged)：语境句：She dragged the heavy suitcase across the floor. 固定搭配：drag on, drag down
D(guided)：语境句：The tour guide guided us through the ancient museum. 固定搭配：guide sb through, guide dog

questions.explanation: 经历了找不到充电桩的焦虑，最终成功充上电，两人开着关于婚姻存续的玩笑。由此可见，作者说这句话时带着“宽慰，如释重负（relief）”的心情。
questions.supplement:
A(regret)：语境句：I deeply regret not studying harder when I was young. 固定搭配：express regret, with regret
B(surprise)：语境句：To my surprise, he passed the difficult driving test easily. 固定搭配：in surprise, take sb by surprise
C(relief)：语境句：He breathed a sigh of relief when he heard the good news. 固定搭配：to one's relief, sigh of relief
D(purpose)：语境句：The main purpose of this meeting is to discuss the budget. 固定搭配：on purpose, for the purpose of

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become available for sale
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般过去时 hit（过去式与原形相同），作谓语，描述电动车的上市事件。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new smartphone model will hit the market next month.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新款智能手机将于下月上市。
vocab_pack.from_passage: When the electric cars initially hit the market

vocab_pack.definition_en: to consider or contemplate
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去进行时 was thinking about，现在分词 thinking 表示持续考虑，后接动名词 buying。
vocab_pack.example_en: I am thinking about changing my job.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我正在考虑换工作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: my husband had been thinking about buying one

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have an angry argument
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去式 quarreled，用于过去完成时 had quarreled，表示在买电动车这件事上已经争吵过。
vocab_pack.example_en: They often quarrel over small matters.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们常为小事争吵。
vocab_pack.from_passage: about which we had quarreled

vocab_pack.definition_en: to drive a vehicle to evaluate its performance before purchase
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般过去式 test-drove，作谓语，描述丈夫试驾电动车。
vocab_pack.example_en: You should test-drive the car before buying it.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 买车前你应该试驾一下。
vocab_pack.from_passage: my husband test-drove an electric car

vocab_pack.definition_en: a journey to a place and back again
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作名词短语修饰 80 miles，表示80英里的往返路程（从家到工作地点来回）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The round trip takes about two hours.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 往返行程大约需要两小时。
vocab_pack.from_passage: 80 miles round trip to and from work

vocab_pack.definition_en: using only one full charge of battery
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作状语，表示在一次充电的情况下，修饰动词 make the whole trip。
vocab_pack.example_en: This electric car can travel 200 miles on a single charge.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这款电动车一次充电能行驶200英里。
vocab_pack.from_passage: make the whole trip on a single charge

vocab_pack.definition_en: operated by electricity from batteries
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 电池驱动的，电池供电的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作定语修饰 one（代指 car），表示一辆电池驱动的车。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many battery-powered tools are cordless.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多电池驱动的工具是无线的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: decided to buy a battery-powered one

vocab_pack.definition_en: to intend to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去完成时 had planned to meet，表示在过去某时间之前已计划好见面。
vocab_pack.example_en: I plan to visit Beijing next year.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我计划明年去北京。
vocab_pack.from_passage: We had planned to meet in Palo Alto

vocab_pack.definition_en: the panel in front of the driver of a vehicle containing instruments and controls
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作名词，所有格 the car's dashboard，表示汽车仪表板。
vocab_pack.example_en: The dashboard shows the speed and fuel level.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 仪表板显示速度和油量。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the car's dashboard (仪表板) showed

vocab_pack.definition_en: remaining, not used up
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作后置定语，修饰 19 miles，表示只剩19英里的电量。
vocab_pack.example_en: There are only ten minutes left before the exam.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 考试前只剩下十分钟。
vocab_pack.from_passage: only 19 miles left on the charge

vocab_pack.definition_en: a place where electric vehicles can recharge their batteries
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数形式 charging stations，作 there are 的主语，表示存在许多充电站。
vocab_pack.example_en: More charging stations are needed for electric cars.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 需要更多电动汽车充电站。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a lot of charging stations in Palo Alto

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to say that something appears to be true
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中引导从句，it 作形式主语，真正主语为 that 从句（there are also a lot of electric cars）。
vocab_pack.example_en: It seems that he is telling the truth.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 看来他在说实话。
vocab_pack.from_passage: But it seems that there are also a lot of electric cars

vocab_pack.definition_en: taken up or filled by
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为被动语态 were occupied by，过去分词 occupied 表示充电位被其他车辆占用。
vocab_pack.example_en: All the seats were occupied by students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 所有座位都被学生占据。
vocab_pack.from_passage: all the charging spots were occupied by other cars

vocab_pack.definition_en: to build or make something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不定式 to construct，作 wants 的宾语补足语（wants to construct），表示加州想要建设充电站。
vocab_pack.example_en: The government plans to construct a new hospital.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 政府计划建造一所新医院。
vocab_pack.from_passage: California wants to construct enough charging stations

vocab_pack.definition_en: producing no exhaust emissions
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作定语修饰 cars（零排放汽车），表示不产生尾气排放的汽车。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many car manufacturers are developing zero-emission vehicles.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多汽车制造商正在研发零排放汽车。
vocab_pack.from_passage: 1 million zero-emission cars

vocab_pack.definition_en: much more progress needed
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作表语，主语 it 指代加州建设充电站的目标，表示距离目标还有很大差距。
vocab_pack.example_en: We have a long way to go before we achieve our goal.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在实现目标之前我们还有很长的路要走。
vocab_pack.from_passage: but obviously it has a long way to go

vocab_pack.definition_en: the time that has been fixed or agreed upon
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作介词宾语（with the appointed time approaching），appointed 为过去分词作定语，表示约定的时间。
vocab_pack.example_en: Please arrive at the appointed time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 请在约定时间到达。
vocab_pack.from_passage: With the appointed time approaching

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come near or nearer
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词 approaching，构成独立主格结构（with the appointed time approaching），表示时间临近。
vocab_pack.example_en: Winter is approaching.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 冬天正在临近。
vocab_pack.from_passage: With the appointed time approaching

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stop trying to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不定式 give up，作 decided 的宾语（decided to give up charging），表示决定放弃充电。
vocab_pack.example_en: Don't give up easily.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 不要轻易放弃。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he decided to give up charging

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go back to a place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去式 returned to，表示回到车库。
vocab_pack.example_en: She returned to her hometown after many years.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 多年后她回到了家乡。
vocab_pack.from_passage: we returned to the garage

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become calm, or to make someone calm
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去式 calmed down，及物用法（calmed down ourselves），表示使我们自己冷静下来。
vocab_pack.example_en: Take a deep breath to calm down.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 深呼吸让自己冷静下来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: We calmed down ourselves

vocab_pack.definition_en: a charging station that is not being used
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作表语（there was one empty charger），empty 为形容词修饰 charger，表示一个空的（未被占用的）充电桩。
vocab_pack.example_en: I finally found an empty charger in the parking lot.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我终于在停车场找到了一个空闲充电器。
vocab_pack.from_passage: there was one empty charger

vocab_pack.definition_en: to pull the charging cable
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去式 pulled the line，表示丈夫拉出充电线。
vocab_pack.example_en: He pulled the line from the charger carefully.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他小心地拉出充电线。
vocab_pack.from_passage: My husband pulled the line from the charger

vocab_pack.definition_en: to connect an electrical device to a power source
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去式 plugged，后接 it（代指充电线）into the front snout，表示将充电线插入接口。
vocab_pack.example_en: Please plug the charger into the socket.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 请将充电器插入插座。
vocab_pack.from_passage: plugged it into the front snout

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become comfortable in a new situation or place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去式 settled in to wait，表示安顿下来等待充电。
vocab_pack.example_en: After moving into the new house, it took a few days to settle in.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 搬进新家后，花了几日才适应。
vocab_pack.from_passage: and settled in to wait

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue to exist despite a difficult situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去式 survived，后接宾语 our first charging crisis，表示我们的婚姻平安度过了首次充电危机。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company survived the financial crisis.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家公司渡过了金融危机。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Our marriage survived our first charging crisis

vocab_pack.definition_en: feeling comfort because something unpleasant has ended

vocab_pack.example_en: Welcome to life with a newborn baby!
vocab_pack.example_zh: 欢迎来到新生儿的生活！

vocab_pack.definition_en: after finishing one's job for the day

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作介词短语，引出信息来源（his phone app），表示根据他的手机应用显示。

section_2_word_form.passage:
Victoria Lu, the first Chinese female curator(策展人) and art critic, started the "Metaverse Art Annual Exhibition @ Venice" in collaboration [56] Ca' Foscari University of Venice and IUAV University of Venice in 2022. This year [57] (mark) the third edition of the exhibition, with Angelo Maggi and Fu Sen continuing as the chief curators.
Since August 16th, a parallel exhibition titled "Weaving Through Time and Space: Dual Islands" [58] (hold) at the M515 Art Center in Shanghai and Calle Scaleta 6039 in Venice through November 16th. This year, the exhibition invited one of the most representative contemporary Chinese [59] (act), who has been experimenting with [60] (vary) multidimensional forms of cross-disciplinary art creation in recent years.
At the Venice exhibition, the Chinese actor's video installation work "Undulations" is an interaction with the dance choreography (舞蹈设计) of Gao Yanjinzi. The work is a documentary [61] combines the dancer's performance with the actor's installation art, [62] (create) a new interpretation specifically for this exhibition.
Besides, Guizhou paper-cutting artist Jiang Honglin, as the first artist to introduce Miao paper-cutting art to the Venice exhibition, gave a live performance during the opening ceremony. Jiang is not only a collector of Miao cultural artifacts, but also probes [63] (deep) into the exploration, organization, and presentation of Miao graphical aesthetics. Meanwhile, Italy-based new media artist Li Mouchu used augmented-reality (增强现实) technology [64] (combine) the paper-cutting art with color, sound, and animation, presenting a performance that mixed both visual [65] auditory elements.

questions.explanation: 考查介词。in collaboration with sb 意为“与某人合作”，为固定搭配。句意为：她与威尼斯两所大学合作启动了年度艺术展。
questions.supplement: 正确形(with)：语境句：The school organized the event in collaboration with local businesses. 固定搭配：in collaboration with, work with. 同类搭配：in cooperation with.

questions.explanation: 考查动词时态和主谓一致。This year 是第三人称单数，表示客观事实或现状应用一般现在时，故填 marks（标志着）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(marks)：语境句：This event marks a significant milestone in our company's history. 固定搭配：mark a turning point, leave a mark. 原词mark其它变形：marker(n.), marked(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查动词时态和语态。时间状语 Since August 16th 暗示动作从过去开始一直持续到现在，故用现在完成时；主语 parallel exhibition 与 hold 之间是被动关系，故填 has been held。
questions.supplement: 正确形(has been held)：语境句：The annual music festival has been held in this city since 2010. 固定搭配：hold an exhibition, hold a meeting. 原词hold其它变形：held(过去式/过去分词), holder(n.)

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。one of the + 形容词最高级 + 复数名词，意为“最……的……之一”。act 对应的表示人的名词是 actor，此处需用复数形式 actors。
questions.supplement: 正确形(actors)：语境句：He is considered one of the most talented actors of his generation. 固定搭配：leading actor, supporting actor. 原词act其它变形：action(n.), active(adj.), activity(n.)

questions.explanation: 考查形容词。空格处的词修饰名词短语 multidimensional forms，需用形容词。vary 的形容词形式为 various，意为“各种各样的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(various)：语境句：The restaurant offers a menu with various healthy options. 固定搭配：various kinds of, for various reasons. 原词vary其它变形：variety(n.), varied(adj.), invariably(adv.)

questions.explanation: 考查定语从句。空格引导限制性定语从句，修饰先行词 documentary，且在从句中作主语，故填关系代词 that 或 which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(that / which)：语境句：This is the book that/which changed my perspective on life. 固定搭配：无特殊固定搭配。常见考点：当先行词被the only, the very等修饰时，只能用that。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。主句句意完整，逗号后引出伴随状态或自然而然的结果，动词 create 与其逻辑主语 documentary 之间为主动关系，故填现在分词 creating 作状语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(creating)：语境句：He worked late into the night, creating a masterpiece. 固定搭配：create an opportunity, create an atmosphere. 原词create其它变形：creation(n.), creative(adj.), creator(n.)

questions.explanation: 考查副词。空格处的词修饰动词 probes，表示“深入地（探究）”，此处多指抽象程度上的深入，通常用 deeply。
questions.supplement: 正确形(deeply)：语境句：We are deeply grateful for your generous support. 固定搭配：probe deeply into, deeply care. 原词deep其它变形：depth(n.), deepen(v.)

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。use sth. to do sth. 为固定搭配，表示“使用某物做某事”，动词不定式作目的状语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to combine)：语境句：She used her spare time to learn a new foreign language. 固定搭配：use sth to do sth, combine A with B. 原词combine其它变形：combination(n.), combined(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查连词。根据空前的 both 可知，此处考查 both A and B 的固定连词搭配，意为“既……又……”，连接 visual 和 auditory elements。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：The project requires both technical skills and creative thinking. 固定搭配：both... and..., between... and...。其它常见关联词：not only... but also..., either... or...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to indicate or be a sign of something important
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'This year marks'使用一般现在时，主语This year为第三人称单数，谓语动词mark加-s。
vocab_pack.example_en: The invention of the printing press marked a turning point in human history.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 印刷术的发明标志着人类历史的转折点。
vocab_pack.from_passage: This year marks the third edition of the exhibition

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take place (of an event, exhibition, etc.)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'has been held'为现在完成时被动语态，结构has been + 过去分词，强调动作已完成且对现在有影响。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Olympic Games will be held in Paris in 2024.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 2024年奥运会将在巴黎举行。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a parallel exhibition ... has been held at the M515 Art Center

vocab_pack.definition_en: typical of a particular group or type; serving as an example
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'representative'作形容词定语，修饰'Chinese actors'，表示'最具有代表性的中国演员之一'。
vocab_pack.example_en: This painting is representative of the artist's early style.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这幅画代表了这位画家早期的风格。
vocab_pack.from_passage: one of the most representative contemporary Chinese actors

vocab_pack.definition_en: belonging to or occurring in the present time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'contemporary'作形容词定语，与'representative'并列，修饰'Chinese actors'。
vocab_pack.example_en: Contemporary art often challenges traditional boundaries.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当代艺术常常挑战传统界限。
vocab_pack.from_passage: one of the most representative contemporary Chinese actors

vocab_pack.definition_en: to try or test new ideas, methods, or activities
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'has been experimenting'为现在完成进行时，主语为单数he，结构has been + 现在分词，强调从过去持续至今仍在进行的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: Scientists have been experimenting with new ways to generate clean energy.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 科学家们一直在尝试产生清洁能源的新方法。
vocab_pack.from_passage: who has been experimenting with various multidimensional forms

vocab_pack.definition_en: different from one another; of several kinds
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'various'作形容词定语，修饰'forms'，表示多种形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: The store offers various types of organic food.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家商店提供各种各样的有机食品。
vocab_pack.from_passage: various multidimensional forms of cross-disciplinary art creation

vocab_pack.definition_en: involving or having many different aspects or dimensions
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'multidimensional'作形容词定语，修饰'forms'，强调形式的多样性。
vocab_pack.example_en: The issue requires a multidimensional approach to solve.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个问题需要多维度的途径来解决。
vocab_pack.from_passage: various multidimensional forms of cross-disciplinary art creation

vocab_pack.definition_en: relating to or involving two or more academic disciplines
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'cross-disciplinary'为复合形容词，修饰'art creation'，强调跨学科的艺术创作。
vocab_pack.example_en: Cross-disciplinary research can lead to groundbreaking discoveries.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 跨学科研究可以带来突破性的发现。
vocab_pack.from_passage: cross-disciplinary art creation

vocab_pack.definition_en: a contemporary art form that uses video technology combined with physical space
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'video installation work'中'video installation'作定语修饰'work'，构成名词短语，意为'视频装置作品'。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum's new exhibition features an immersive video installation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 博物馆的新展览展出了一个沉浸式视频装置。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the Chinese actor's video installation work "Undulations"

vocab_pack.definition_en: a mutual or reciprocal action or influence between two things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'interaction with'为名词短语，后接宾语'the dance choreography'，作表语部分，说明视频装置作品的性质。
vocab_pack.example_en: The study focuses on the interaction between humans and artificial intelligence.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这项研究关注人与人工智能之间的互动。
vocab_pack.from_passage: video installation work "Undulations" is an interaction with the dance choreography

vocab_pack.definition_en: the art or practice of designing sequences of steps and movements in dance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'choreography'作名词，'dance choreography'指舞蹈编舞，作为介词with的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ballet's choreography was praised for its creativity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这场芭蕾舞的编舞因其创意而受到赞扬。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the dance choreography of Gao Yanjinzi

vocab_pack.definition_en: to join or mix together to form a whole
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'combines'为定语从句的谓语动词，先行词为documentary，故用第三人称单数一般现在时。
vocab_pack.example_en: The recipe combines simple ingredients to create a delicious meal.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个食谱将简单的食材结合，做出美味的一餐。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The work is a documentary that/which combines the dancer's performance with the actor's installation art

vocab_pack.definition_en: to bring something into existence
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'creating'为现在分词，作结果状语，表示主动的伴随动作，前面有逗号隔开。
vocab_pack.example_en: The team hopes to create a more efficient system for data analysis.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该团队希望创建一个更高效的数据分析系统。
vocab_pack.from_passage: creating a new interpretation specifically for this exhibition

vocab_pack.definition_en: a particular explanation or way of understanding something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'interpretation'为名词，作creating的宾语，'a new interpretation'指一种新的诠释方式。
vocab_pack.example_en: The actor gave a fresh interpretation of the classic role.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位演员对这个经典角色进行了新的诠释。
vocab_pack.from_passage: creating a new interpretation specifically for this exhibition

vocab_pack.definition_en: designed or intended for a particular purpose or person
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'specifically for'为介词短语，修饰'interpretation'，表示这次诠释是专门为本次展览而作的。
vocab_pack.example_en: The software was developed specifically for educational purposes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这款软件是专门为教育目的而开发的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: specifically for this exhibition

vocab_pack.definition_en: to perform in front of an audience in real time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'gave a live performance'为一般过去时，主语Jiang Honglin，gave为give的过去式，表示过去发生的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: The band will give a live performance at the festival next weekend.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这支乐队将在下周末的音乐节上进行现场表演。
vocab_pack.from_passage: gave a live performance during the opening ceremony

vocab_pack.definition_en: the traditional craft of cutting paper into decorative designs
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'paper-cutting art'为名词短语，作宾语，前面有'Miao'限定，指苗族剪纸艺术。
vocab_pack.example_en: Paper-cutting art is a UNESCO intangible cultural heritage in China.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 剪纸艺术是联合国教科文组织认定的中国非物质文化遗产。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Miao paper-cutting art to the Venice exhibition

vocab_pack.definition_en: to investigate or examine something thoroughly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'probes deeply into'为一般现在时第三人称单数，副词deeply修饰probes，强调深入的程度。
vocab_pack.example_en: The journalist probed into the company's financial records to uncover fraud.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 记者深入调查了公司的财务记录以揭露欺诈行为。
vocab_pack.from_passage: but also probes deeply into the exploration, organization, and presentation of Miao graphical aesthetics

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act of traveling to or examining an unfamiliar area or subject
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'exploration'为名词，与organization、presentation并列作介词into的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The exploration of space has led to many technological advances.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 太空探索带来了许多技术进步。
vocab_pack.from_passage: exploration, organization, and presentation of Miao graphical aesthetics

vocab_pack.definition_en: the giving or showing of something in a formal way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'presentation'为名词，与exploration、organization并列，表示对苗族图形美学的探索、组织和呈现。
vocab_pack.example_en: The presentation of the research findings was clear and well-organized.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 研究结果的呈现清晰且组织良好。
vocab_pack.from_passage: exploration, organization, and presentation of Miao graphical aesthetics

vocab_pack.definition_en: the visual appeal and artistic qualities of graphic designs
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'graphical aesthetics'为名词短语，作介词of的宾语，指苗族图形美学的概念。
vocab_pack.example_en: The graphical aesthetics of the website significantly influence user experience.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 网站的图形美学显著影响用户体验。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Miao graphical aesthetics

vocab_pack.definition_en: relating to a technology that overlays digital information onto the real world
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 增强现实的（复合形容词）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'augmented-reality'为复合形容词，修饰'technology'，表示增强现实技术。
vocab_pack.example_en: Augmented-reality applications are becoming increasingly popular in education.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 增强现实应用在教育中越来越受欢迎。
vocab_pack.from_passage: augmented-reality technology to combine the paper-cutting art

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: to combine the paper-cutting art with color, sound, and animation
vocab_pack.definition_en: to join or mix one thing with another
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'to combine...with...'为不定式短语作目的状语，表示用增强现实技术将剪纸艺术与色彩、声音和动画相结合。
vocab_pack.example_en: The architect combined modern materials with traditional styles in the building design.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 建筑师在设计中把现代材料与传统风格结合起来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to combine the paper-cutting art with color, sound, and animation

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show or offer something for others to see or consider
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'presenting'为现在分词，作伴随状语，与主语Li Mouchu是主动关系，表示同时进行的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: The artist will present her latest works at the gallery next month.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位艺术家下个月将在画廊展示她的最新作品。
vocab_pack.from_passage: presenting a performance that mixed both visual and auditory elements

vocab_pack.definition_en: to combine or blend different things together
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'mixed'为定语从句的谓语动词，先行词performance，使用一般过去时表示混合了视觉和听觉元素。
vocab_pack.example_en: The DJ mixed various music genres to create a unique sound.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位DJ混合了多种音乐风格，创造出了独特的声音。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a performance that mixed both visual and auditory elements

vocab_pack.definition_en: relating to seeing or sight
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'visual'作形容词，与auditory并列，修饰'elements'，表示视觉元素。
vocab_pack.example_en: Visual effects play a crucial role in modern cinema.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 视觉效果在现代电影中起着关键作用。
vocab_pack.from_passage: both visual and auditory elements

vocab_pack.definition_en: relating to hearing or the sense of hearing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'auditory'作形容词，与visual并列，修饰'elements'，表示听觉元素。
vocab_pack.example_en: The auditory system processes sound waves and converts them into signals for the brain.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 听觉系统处理声波并将其转化为大脑的信号。
vocab_pack.from_passage: both visual and auditory elements

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to emphasize that two things are equally true or included
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'both visual and auditory'为并列连词结构，连接两个形容词，强调表演融合了视觉和听觉两种元素。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new policy benefits both employers and employees.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新政策对雇主和雇员都有利。
vocab_pack.from_passage: both visual and auditory elements

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be a person who collects specific items as a hobby or profession
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'is a collector of'为系表结构，一般现在时，主语Jiang Honglin第三人称单数，用is。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is a collector of rare stamps from all over the world.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她是一位来自世界各地的稀有邮票收藏家。
vocab_pack.from_passage: not only a collector of Miao cultural artifacts

vocab_pack.definition_en: objects made or used by people that represent a particular culture
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中'cultural artifacts'为名词短语，作介词of的宾语，表示苗族文化器物。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum houses a large collection of ancient cultural artifacts.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 博物馆收藏了大量古代文化文物。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Miao cultural artifacts
